brief.headline: Road 15-1006-1 is predicted to fall to Very Poor (PCI 38.2) by the next survey; the recommended action is corrective.
brief.condition_now: The road is currently rated Fair, with a PCI of 58.9. The dominant distress is longitudinal and transverse cracking at high severity, rut depth is 9.5 mm (low severity), and the pavement is 14.8 years old.
brief.outlook: At the next survey, about 2.4 years away, the model predicts a PCI of 38.2 (Very Poor). Its typical error is 14.2 points, so the likely range is 24 to 52.3. Rut depth is predicted to be 9.5 mm (low severity), with a typical error of 5.2 mm and a likely range of 4.3 to 14.6 mm. The driver effects are measured from the model's average predictions of PCI 69.5 and rut depth 23.1 mm.
drivers: The current PCI of 58.9 lowered the model's PCI estimate by 18.6 points.
The current rating not being Good lowered the PCI estimate by a further 2.6 points.
An annual freeze–thaw count of 0 lowered the PCI estimate by 2.2 points.
Roughness (IRI, left wheel path) of 2.39 m/km lowered the PCI estimate by 2.2 points.
The current rut depth of 9.5 mm lowered the model's rut depth estimate by 10.8 mm.
The rut depth at the previous survey, also 9.5 mm, lowered the rut depth estimate by 1.9 mm.
Average solar radiation at the surface (194,102) lowered the rut depth estimate by 0.4 mm.
Annual evaporation (1,668) lowered the rut depth estimate by 0.4 mm.
brief.repair: The repair classifier flags this road, with an estimated 97% probability that PCI will fall below 55. On test data it caught 31 of 39 roads that needed repair, and 78% of the roads it flagged did need repair.
brief.action: Corrective: programme a detailed inspection with a view to corrective treatment, because the repair classifier flags this survey and the predicted PCI is below the repair threshold.
caveats: On held-out data the rutting model was not reliably more accurate than simply assuming rut depth stays as it is now.
The drivers describe how the model reached its estimate; they are not evidence of why the pavement deteriorates.
